text.en: Oh, hello. Can I help you?

text.en: Morning prayers are just over. If you want holy water, you will have to wait for the deacon; he has the key.
text.zh: 晨祷刚做完。你若要领圣水，得等执事回来，钥匙在他身上。

text.en: Pilgrims come into the city every day now. The inns have been full for weeks, and plenty of them sleep out on the squares.
text.zh: 这阵子天天有朝圣的人进城，客栈早就住满了，好多人只能在广场上过夜。

text.en: Don't go out after dark. Those things out in the wilds — there weren't this many of them last year.
text.zh: 天黑以后别往外走。野地里那些东西，去年还没这么多。

text.en: What are you doing out at this hour? If you've no business here, go and get some sleep. Don't hang about.
text.zh: 这么晚了，你在这儿做什么？没事就回去睡觉，别在这儿转悠。

text.zh: 在这儿把刀收好。有什么麻烦就来找我们，别自己动手。

text.en: Oh, hello. Can I help you?
text.zh: 啊，你好。找我有事吗？

text.en: Iron has doubled in price these two months, and half the time there's none to be had at any price. I'll take mending, but anything new you'll have to wait for.
text.zh: 铁料这两个月涨了一倍，还常常有钱也买不到。修补的活我接，要打新的就得等。

text.en: Everyone wants door bars and shutter bolts lately, and they want them thick. If you've something to mend, leave it there and come back tomorrow.
text.zh: 最近来打门闩、窗栓的人多，都要厚的。有要修的东西就放那边，明天来拿。

text.en: Pilgrims come into the city every day now. The inns have been full for weeks, and plenty of them sleep out on the squares.
text.zh: 这阵子天天有朝圣的人进城，客栈早就住满了，好多人只能在广场上过夜。

text.en: Oh, hello. Can I help you?
text.zh: 啊，你好。找我有事吗？

text.en: Up already? The bakery isn't open yet. I want the first batch; flour is short, and by mid-morning there's nothing left.
text.zh: 这么早就起了？面包房还没开门呢。我得赶第一炉，这阵子面粉紧，晚了就买不着了。

text.en: Watch the rut at the end of the lane. The rain dug it deeper, and a cart tipped over in it the day before yesterday.
text.zh: 巷口那道车辙你留神点。下过一场雨又冲深了，前天还有辆车在那儿翻了。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。

text.en: Hello. I haven't seen you before. Are you from out of town?
text.zh: 你好。没见过你，是外地来的吧？

text.en: I want these rows hoed by noon. This afternoon I'm helping next door mend their pigsty. I promised.
text.zh: 我得趁上午把这几垄锄完。下午要去帮邻居家修猪圈，早就说好了的。

text.en: The wheat came into ear nearly half a month late this year, and the ears are thin. My father farmed forty years and says he never saw the like.
text.zh: 今年的麦子抽穗晚了快半个月，穗子也瘪。我爹种了四十年地，说从没见过这样的。

text.en: Pilgrims come into the city every day now. The inns have been full for weeks, and plenty of them sleep out on the squares.
text.zh: 这阵子天天有朝圣的人进城，客栈早就住满了，好多人只能在广场上过夜。

text.en: Hello. I haven't seen you before. Are you from out of town?
text.zh: 你好。没见过你，是外地来的吧？

text.en: I've turned the east rows twice this week and the soil is still hard. Other years it would be loose by now.
text.zh: 东边那几垄我这礼拜翻了两遍，土还是硬邦邦的。往年这时候早就松了。

text.en: I want these rows hoed by noon. This afternoon I'm helping next door mend their pigsty. I promised.
text.zh: 我得趁上午把这几垄锄完。下午要去帮邻居家修猪圈，早就说好了的。

text.en: Oh, hello. Can I help you?
text.zh: 啊，你好。找我有事吗？

text.en: I want these rows hoed by noon. This afternoon I'm helping next door mend their pigsty. I promised.
text.zh: 我得趁上午把这几垄锄完。下午要去帮邻居家修猪圈，早就说好了的。

text.en: Rain. Good. Walk round, would you, and don't step in the furrows I just opened.
text.zh: 下雨了，好。你绕着点走，别踩我刚开的沟。

text.en: Pilgrims come into the city every day now. The inns have been full for weeks, and plenty of them sleep out on the squares.

text.en: Hello. I haven't seen you before. Are you from out of town?
text.zh: 你好。没见过你，是外地来的吧？

text.en: I'm packing up. Buy now if you want anything; I'm off early tomorrow to restock.
text.zh: 我要收摊了。要买趁现在，明天我得一早去进货。

text.en: Have a look, take your time. Don't ask for lamp oil, though. Not a drop has come in this month, and every house is short.
text.zh: 要什么随便看。灯油就别问了，这个月一滴都没进来，家家都缺。

text.en: Pilgrims come into the city every day now. The inns have been full for weeks, and plenty of them sleep out on the squares.

text.en: Hello. I haven't seen you before. Are you from out of town?
text.zh: 你好。没见过你，是外地来的吧？

text.en: Can you hop to the well and back on one foot? I can. I did twenty hops without switching.
text.zh: 你能单脚跳到井边再跳回来吗？我能，我跳了二十下都没换脚。

text.en: I have to go home, Mum's calling me for supper. I'm not tired. I'm really not.
text.zh: 我得回家了，我娘喊我吃饭。我不困，真的不困。

text.en: Salt has gone up again; it costs me a third more to buy in than last month. I can't help it. If it's too dear, buy less.
text.zh: 盐又涨了，进价比上个月高了三成。我也没办法，你要是嫌贵，就少买点。

text.en: Needles, thread, buttons, torches, bait, I have all of that. Have a look; after this town, the next market is four days off.
text.zh: 针线、扣子、火把、鱼饵，都有。看看吧，过了这个镇子，下一个集要走四天。

text.zh: 你好啊，从哪儿来的？这阵子过路的人真多。

text.en: Keep your blade sheathed while you're here. If there's trouble, come to us. Don't settle it yourself.
text.zh: 在这儿把刀收好。有什么麻烦就来找我们，别自己动手。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。

text.en: Hello. I haven't seen you before. Are you from out of town?
text.zh: 你好。没见过你，是外地来的吧？

text.en: What are you doing out at this hour? If you've no business here, go and get some sleep. Don't hang about.
text.zh: 这么晚了，你在这儿做什么？没事就回去睡觉，别在这儿转悠。

text.en: Don't go out after dark. Those things out in the wilds — there weren't this many of them last year.
text.zh: 天黑以后别往外走。野地里那些东西，去年还没这么多。

text.en: Pilgrims come into the city every day now. The inns have been full for weeks, and plenty of them sleep out on the squares.

text.en: Half the company was sent off again last month to escort pilgrims, they said. The rest of us stand two posts each.
text.zh: 上个月又调走了半个队，说是去护送朝圣的人。剩下我们几个，一人守两个岗。

text.zh: 天不亮就操练，练完了还得去挖壕沟。我这手上的泡就没消过。

text.en: Hello. I haven't seen you before. Are you from out of town?
text.zh: 你好。没见过你，是外地来的吧？

text.en: Stand aside, if you would. My coachman has gone for someone to mend the wheel, and I can hardly wait in the mud.
text.zh: 劳驾让一让。我的车夫找人修车轮去了，我总不能站在泥里等着。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。

text.en: Hello there. Where are you from? So many people have been passing through lately.
text.zh: 你好啊，从哪儿来的？这阵子过路的人真多。

text.en: I'm copying the pilgrim rolls for the Church: names sent in from every parish, dozens a day. By noon my hand aches.
text.zh: 我在替教会誊朝圣者的名册。各地报上来的名字，一天就有好几十个，抄到中午手就酸了。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。

text.en: Oh, hello. Can I help you?
text.zh: 啊，你好。找我有事吗？

text.en: Iron has doubled in price these two months, and half the time there's none to be had at any price. I'll take mending, but anything new you'll have to wait for.
text.zh: 铁料这两个月涨了一倍，还常常有钱也买不到。修补的活我接，要打新的就得等。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。

text.en: Oh, hello. Can I help you?
text.zh: 啊，你好。找我有事吗？

text.en: I've turned the east rows twice this week and the soil is still hard. Other years it would be loose by now.
text.zh: 东边那几垄我这礼拜翻了两遍，土还是硬邦邦的。往年这时候早就松了。

text.en: Rain. Good. Walk round, would you, and don't step in the furrows I just opened.
text.zh: 下雨了，好。你绕着点走，别踩我刚开的沟。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。

text.en: Hello there. Where are you from? So many people have been passing through lately.
text.zh: 你好啊，从哪儿来的？这阵子过路的人真多。

text.en: I want these rows hoed by noon. This afternoon I'm helping next door mend their pigsty. I promised.
text.zh: 我得趁上午把这几垄锄完。下午要去帮邻居家修猪圈，早就说好了的。

text.en: Hello there. Where are you from? So many people have been passing through lately.
text.zh: 你好啊，从哪儿来的？这阵子过路的人真多。

text.en: Morning prayers are just over. If you want holy water, you will have to wait for the deacon; he has the key.
text.zh: 晨祷刚做完。你若要领圣水，得等执事回来，钥匙在他身上。

text.en: If you are weary, traveller, come in and sit. Many come to light candles of late; the chapel is brighter than it used to be.
text.zh: 旅人，若是累了，便进来坐坐。近来点烛的人多，堂里倒比往日亮些。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。

text.en: Hello. I haven't seen you before. Are you from out of town?
text.zh: 你好。没见过你，是外地来的吧？

text.en: The wheat came into ear nearly half a month late this year, and the ears are thin. My father farmed forty years and says he never saw the like.
text.zh: 今年的麦子抽穗晚了快半个月，穗子也瘪。我爹种了四十年地，说从没见过这样的。

text.en: Hello there. Where are you from? So many people have been passing through lately.
text.zh: 你好啊，从哪儿来的？这阵子过路的人真多。

text.en: Done at last. I'll fetch a bucket from the well, and then there's supper to make for the whole house.
text.zh: 活总算干完了。我去井边打桶水，回来还得给一家子做饭。

text.en: It gets dark earlier every day. Our lamp oil used to last till spring; this year I doubt it will see midwinter.
text.zh: 天黑得一天比一天早了。我家的灯油往年能点到开春，今年怕是撑不到冬至。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。

text.en: Oh, hello. Can I help you?
text.zh: 啊，你好。找我有事吗？

text.en: Up already? The bakery isn't open yet. I want the first batch; flour is short, and by mid-morning there's nothing left.
text.zh: 这么早就起了？面包房还没开门呢。我得赶第一炉，这阵子面粉紧，晚了就买不着了。

text.en: You're not from here, are you? There have been more people on the road than usual lately. They say the Church is calling for pilgrims.
text.zh: 你是外地来的吧？这阵子路上的人比往年多，听说是教会在召朝圣的人。

text.en: Care for a song? One coin each. I've just learned a pilgrims' song from people on the road. It has seventeen verses.
text.zh: 想听首歌吗？一枚钱一首。我刚跟路上的朝圣者学了一首歌，一共十七段。

text.en: Mind your purse in the crowd by the gate.
text.zh: 城门边人多，看好你的钱袋。
